scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:worker
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --cwd worker deploy
scripts.dev: bun run build:web && bun run preview && bun run --cwd worker dev
scripts.showcase: bun run showcase:prepare && bun run preview
scripts.typecheck: bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && bun run --bun tsc -p worker && bun run --cwd web typecheck

EMAIL_LOGIN_SIGNING_KEY.description: Dedicated Ed25519 email-login identity key: PKCS#8 DER as standard base64. Register its SSH public key as hotaisle-console in hotManager EMAIL_AUTH_CLIENTS. Never reuse session or history secrets.

HISTORY_SECRET.description: Stable, dedicated 32+ character secret for browser history. Back up securely; changing it makes existing encrypted history unreadable.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Encrypts sign-in sessions. 32 or more random characters: `openssl rand -base64 32`.
